summaries.name: the user's basil plant
summaries.summary: The user's basil plant is kept on the balcony and has been struggling from too much direct sunlight as of 2023-05-23. It is being moved to a shadier spot with filtered/indirect sunlight, with reduced watering frequency, sparse fertilization at half strength, and regular pruning of flower buds and leggy stems, kept at daytime temperatures of 65-75°F (18-24°C). The user has been using a general-purpose potting mix and is considering a well-draining mix with perlite/vermiculite/sand, a pH of 6.0-7.0, and added organic matter like compost or peat moss.
